# crosswork_l3vpn_qos_profile_ids (Resource)

This resource can manage a QoS profile id of the L3VPN service model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_l3vpn_qos_profile_ids" "example" {
  name = "cwtest-qos"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the QoS profile. Any ASCII character except `%`, `?` and `#`.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_l3vpn_qos_profile_ids.example "<name>"
```
